output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is set to a large value, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary amounts of tokens to any user account.

The transferFrom function allows attackers to steal funds from user accounts. The function does not check if the balance of the target user is sufficient, allowing attackers to transfer any amount of tokens from any user accounts to their own.
The approve function has a bad randomness, allowing attackers to approve arbitrary spender accounts to transfer funds from user accounts.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing attackers to burn arbitrary amounts of tokens from user accounts.
The mintToken function has a token devalue vulnerability, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary amounts of tokens, causing the token value to decrease.
